name: house-lights
description: Eight skills for showing an idea to people: teach it by drawing (chalk-talk), present it (back-of-napkin), rehearse an incident (dress-rehearsal), map a team's way of working (gates-and-handoffs) and a customer journey (service-blueprint), compare Copilot Studio agents (cast-list), simulate a process to ask «what if» (box-office), and put the whole process together as one solution (opening-night) — with a mod that checks each recipe as Claude writes it.
